_doc: Per-issue spawn registry (Kevin, 2026-08-20: 'write starting positions for each issue you fix so that you can start right where the issue is'). tools/set_start_blend.py moves AC_START_0/AC_HOTLAP_START_0 (+ the AC_PIT_n row behind) to positions[active] in the prepped blend, between the build_kn5_loop prep and the kn5 export. vertex indexes into data/centerline.local.json (post-smoothing); offset_right_m is lateral in the driving direction (right-hand lane; keeps the car off the median island).

seam-alvarado._doc: Default lap-seam start (the turn onto Alvarado — also C3/0034's inspection point). vertex 0 + offset 0 = leave the prep's own placement untouched.

0037-college-median._doc: Mid-College inside the big divided run (verts 770-1280): median island on the left, barriers/planting visible, Del Cerro mouth gap ~250 m ahead.

0037-navajo-north._doc: Navajo's first divided run (verts 1519-1761) — the stretch that went janky on the first median attempt; verify the corner buffer and the island here.

0033-college-del-cerro._doc: Just before the College/Del Cerro junction mouth (island gap 1072-1100) — C2's criss-crossing-sidewalks site.

0033-navajo-jackson._doc: Approach to Navajo/Jackson (just past Navajo's second divided run, 2162-2319) — C2's other junction site. Refine vertex when C2 starts.
